item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continue striking Ukrainian civilian sites, including an apartment block that killed at least nine people and a recent blast in Lviv, while Ukrainian drones have hit Russian vessels at Libya's Benghazi port and a refinery in Novoshakhtinsk. Poland reported a failed Russian attempt to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper, and Russian missile debris was found after an airspace incursion over Poland. Estonia closed its border with Russia following a GRU-linked sabotage attack. The conflict also saw Russian attacks on a cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland and another vessel in the Baltic Sea. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

The United Nations backed a joint coast guard task force to improve Red Sea security, and dozens of children were killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities, with 918 battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
